jcr:content.jcr:title: Ashford Cultural Centre
jcr:content.jcr:description: A regional arts and education hub combining gallery, library, and performance spaces under a single expressive roof.

text.text: The Ashford Cultural Centre anchors the town's creative quarter with a sculptural form that draws visitors through layered public spaces — from an open-air courtyard to intimate reading rooms, culminating in a 400-seat performance hall.
